source.author: ov
source.text: Utque domus altae partem tenuere remotam, tendentemque manus et iam sua fata videntem et mater, mater clamantem et colla petentem ense ferit Procne, lateri qua pectus adhaeret, nec vultum vertit.
source.text_original: Utque domus altae partem tenuere remotam, / tendentemque manus et iam sua fata videntem / et 'mater, mater' clamantem et colla petentem / ense ferit Procne, lateri qua pectus adhaeret, / nec vultum vertit.
source.text_english: And when they had reached a remote part of the high house, and he was stretching out his hands and now seeing his fate, and his mother, his mother, crying out and reaching for his neck, Procne struck him with the sword in the side where the breast joins it, and did not turn away her face.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Whom does he strike with his sword?
